By: Test Author A  H.B. No. 21

A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT relating to the appraisal of a residence homestead for ad valorem tax purposes.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF TEXAS:

SECTION 1. Section 23.23, Tax Code, is amended. The chief appraiser of an appraisal district shall limit the appraised value of a residence homestead. Section 11.13, Tax Code, applies.

SECTION 2. This Act takes effect January 1, 2028.
